_readme: Webhook tools for the ElevenLabs agent. Create each under Agent → Tools → Add tool → Webhook. Replace YOUR-N8N with your n8n cloud subdomain. The 'response' blocks document what your n8n workflow must return — the agent reads this JSON to speak the result.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check open appointment slots. ALWAYS call this before offering any appointment time to the caller. Returns up to 3 available slots.

preferred_date.description: Caller's preferred date in YYYY-MM-DD. If they said 'next Tuesday', convert to the actual date.

treatment.description: What the appointment is for, e.g. 'checkup', 'hygienist', 'filling', 'emergency'

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Book a confirmed appointment. Only call AFTER the caller has confirmed their full name, mobile number, and chosen slot aloud.

patient_name.description: Full name as confirmed by caller

phone.description: Mobile number as confirmed by caller

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD from a slot returned by check_availability

time.description: HH:MM from a slot returned by check_availability

is_new_patient.description: True if never attended the practice before

is_reschedule.description: True if replacing an existing appointment (outbound reminder flow)

notes.description: Anything else relevant, e.g. 'nervous patient', 'prefers Dr. Byrne'

response_example.spoken_confirmation: Booked for Tuesday the 21st of July at half nine

tools.name: log_callback
tools.description: Log a request for staff to call the person back. Use for anything you cannot resolve: unanswered questions, prescription queries, complaints, cancellations, out-of-hours urgent matters.

reason.description: One-sentence summary of what they need

category.description: Exactly one of: callback | cancellation | complaint | prescription | do-not-call

response_example.message: Callback logged, staff will ring back

tools.name: capture_prsi_details
tools.description: Securely record a patient's details for a PRSI Treatment Benefit entitlement check. ONLY call when the caller wants to use their PRSI entitlement and has confirmed name, date of birth, and PPS number aloud. Never use for any other purpose.

patient_name.description: Full name as confirmed by caller

pps_number.description: 7 digits followed by 1-2 letters, e.g. 1234567FA. Confirmed digit by digit with the caller.

phone.description: Caller's mobile, for staff follow-up if entitlement check fails

response_example.message: Details recorded, staff will confirm entitlement before the appointment

transfer_to_number.note: Configure in ElevenLabs as native call transfer (Twilio). Set the practice line as destination. Add condition text: 'Transfer when caller explicitly asks for a human, is distressed, has a complaint, or has an urgent clinical matter during opening hours Mon-Fri 08:30-17:30.'

end_call.note: Enable native end_call so the agent can hang up gracefully after goodbye.

security_note: In each n8n webhook node, require a shared-secret header (e.g. X-Auth-Token) and add the same header in the ElevenLabs tool config, so only your agents can hit these endpoints.
